map.闪光指数计算 使用指南: Flash Guide Number Calculation User Guide
map.闪光指数计算工具依据闪光指数 GN 与光圈求闪光有效距离（ISO100 标定），: The flash guide number calculator derives the effective flash distance (calibrated at ISO100) from the guide number GN and the aperture, suited to setting shooting distance and exposure for night and portrait fill light.
map.距离 = GN / fISO 加倍，距离 ×√2: distance = GN / f; doubling ISO multiplies the distance by sqrt(2)
map.由 GN 与 ISO 求有效照明距离。: Derive the effective lighting distance from GN and ISO.
map.：GN=40、ISO100、f/4：ISO100 距离 = GN/f = 40/: GN = 40, ISO100, f/4: the ISO100 distance = GN/f = 40/4 = 10m; at ISO400 the factor is 2, so the real distance = 20m, farther and still properly exposed.
map.：距 8m、GN40、ISO100：所需 f = 40/8 = f/5，开于 f: At 8m with GN40 and ISO100 the required aperture is f = 40/8 = f/5; opening to f/4 overexposes and stopping to f/8 underexposes.
map.距离和 ISO 什么关系？: What is the relation between distance and ISO?
map.有效距离随 √(ISO/100) 增；高 ISO 让闪光打得更远或可用更小光圈。: The effective range grows with sqrt(ISO/100); a higher ISO makes the flash reach farther or lets you use a smaller aperture.
map.为什么还要调光圈？: Why adjust the aperture as well?
map.GN 固定时距离与光圈互锁，改其一必调另一，ISO 是第三变量三者联立。: With GN fixed, distance and aperture interlock: change one and you must adjust the other. ISO is the third variable, and all three solve together.
